messages.subject: Load GenomeWideSNP_6 CDF file
parts:
Hi,
I am trying to load the GenomeWideSNP_6 CDF file by following the
procedure below but it fails with an error. I guess this is an issue
with the path where AffymetrixCdfFile$fromChipType is looking for the
CDF file but I haven't been able to solve it. Any ideas?

Thank you so much
Nicolas

messages.author: e3daea24651c4835
messages.subject: Re: Load GenomeWideSNP_6 CDF file
parts:
OK, I just figured out that the annotation files were to be put in
annotationData/chipTypes/<chip type>/ !
Sorry..
You might actually want to put a link to http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/
in the user cases pages such as
http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/total-copy-number-analysis-6-0
, which is why I didn't see it at first.
Thank you.
Nicolas
